question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Across**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Across is the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
 
• **Across **refers to moving from one side to the other side of something.
 
 
• **Example**: *She walked across the bridge, enjoying the scenic view of the river below.*
 
 
 
• The sentence suggests that the data in the row is spread out or distributed across something.

Thus, **option 3** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **From **is typically used to indicate a starting point, source, or origin.
 
• **Between **is used when referring to two distinct, individual items or groups.
 
• **Amongst **is used when referring to a relationship involving three or more items or people.
